seed_strategy: For each task, LeRobot v0.6.1 resets episode_index i with EVAL_SEED + i when eval.batch_size=1.
initial_state_provenance: LeRobot LIBERO v0.6.1 does not expose a benchmark initial-state ID in eval_info.json; paired reset seeds are the controlled provenance.
rendered_manifest: Each run writes paired_seed_manifest.json into its output directory.
